name: standing broad jump (timed strip)
rules: Cell 1 is ONLY the character reference; the animation is cells 2 to 11.
Keep exactly the same character size as cell 1 in every cell (same helmet size, same pixel size); only the pose changes.
On ground frames the feet stand on the same ground line; the character jumps mostly upward, with little forward travel.
Rising frames: limbs trail behind. Falling frames: arms up, legs reaching forward-down, head level.
The pink scarf lags one frame behind the body: up while crouching, trailing back/down while rising, streaming UP while falling, settling after landing.

frames.pose: reference: the original standing pose, unchanged
stand tall, weight up, both arms raised slightly in front
dip: knees bending, the body 3 pixels lower, both arms swinging back
deep crouch: the head 9 pixels lower than standing, torso leaning 45 degrees forward, thighs nearly horizontal, both arms fully back behind the hips
push: legs extending, the body rising, arms swinging forward, back toe still on the ground
take-off: the whole body one straight diagonal line from the back toe (still touching the ground) to the fingertips reaching forward-up; stretched
apex: in the air 10 pixels above the standing height, knees tucked up toward the chest, arms forward; scarf trailing back and down
descent: in the air 6 pixels up, both arms raised up for balance, legs reaching forward and down, head level; scarf streaming upward
landing crouch: feet on the ground line, head 9 pixels lower than standing, knees bent about 90 degrees, arms forward and down; scarf still up
rise: coming up, head 4 pixels lower than standing, arms lowering; scarf falling
stand: the standing pose of cell 2; scarf settling
